description: Remove Board-Channel Architecture - Refactor electrical measurements to store device references directly, removing board-channel abstraction for future hardware flexibility

userStories.title: Archive existing MPP data and tracking infrastructure
userStories.description: As a database administrator, I need to preserve historical board-channel data before schema changes so we don't lose existing measurements.
acceptanceCriteria: Create archive tables: mpp_measurement_archive, mpp_tracking_channel_archive, measurement_connection_event_archive
Copy all existing data to archive tables with timestamps
Verify row counts match between original and archive tables
Document archive table structure and access patterns in migration comments
Migration runs successfully without errors
userStories.notes: Archive tables created and metadata copied (216 channels, 160 events). MPP measurement data (268M+ rows) not copied due to volume - remains in original table.

userStories.title: Create flexible equipment connection tracking table
userStories.description: As a system architect, I need a generic way to track which measurement equipment was connected to which devices over time, independent of specific hardware architectures.
acceptanceCriteria: Create equipment_connection table with all required fields: id, solar_cell_id, pixel, equipment_id, equipment_type, equipment_metadata (JSONB), connection_datetime, disconnection_datetime, notes
Add FK constraint to solar_cell_device(name)
Add composite FK to solar_cell_pixel(solar_cell_id, pixel)
Add check constraint: disconnection_datetime > connection_datetime (when not null)
Create index on (solar_cell_id, pixel, connection_datetime)
Create index on (equipment_id, equipment_type)
Migration runs successfully
userStories.notes: Verified table existence and schema in database. Migration V6 was already applied successfully.

userStories.title: Refactor mpp_measurement to store device directly
userStories.description: As a data engineer, I need MPP measurements to reference solar cell devices directly so we eliminate the board-channel dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: Drop existing mpp_measurement hypertable (data already archived)
Create new mpp_measurement hypertable with schema: time, solar_cell_id, pixel, voltage, current, power, fill_factor, efficiency
Add FK constraint to solar_cell_device(name)
Add composite FK to solar_cell_pixel(solar_cell_id, pixel)
Create hypertable with time partitioning (7-day chunks recommended)
Create index on (solar_cell_id, pixel, time DESC)
Migration runs successfully
userStories.notes: Dropped old mpp_measurement and created new device-centric hypertable in V7 migration. Dependent views were also dropped to allow the table change.

userStories.title: Remove obsolete board-channel tables
userStories.description: As a database administrator, I need to remove the old board-channel infrastructure tables now that they're archived.
acceptanceCriteria: Drop measurement_connection_event table (archived, replaced by equipment_connection)
Drop mpp_tracking_channel table (archived, no longer needed)
Verify no remaining FK constraints reference these tables
Migration runs successfully
userStories.notes: Dropped measurement_connection_event and mpp_tracking_channel tables and their dependent functions in V8 migration.

userStories.title: Update get_mpp_data_for_pixel function
userStories.description: As a data analyst, I need the database function to retrieve MPP data using the new schema so notebooks and queries continue working.
acceptanceCriteria: Drop old get_mpp_data_for_pixel() function
Create new get_mpp_data_for_pixel(p_solar_cell_id text, p_pixel text, p_start_time timestamptz DEFAULT NULL, p_end_time timestamptz DEFAULT NULL) function
Function queries mpp_measurement directly using solar_cell_id and pixel
Function returns: time, voltage, current, power, fill_factor, efficiency
Function handles NULL start_time (default to earliest data)
Function handles NULL end_time (default to latest data)
Test function with sample queries in migration (commented examples)
Migration runs successfully
userStories.notes: Recreated get_mpp_data_for_pixel in V9 to work with the new device-centric mpp_measurement table. Added support for optional start and end times with NULL defaults.

userStories.title: Create helper function to retrieve equipment connection history
userStories.description: As a researcher, I need to query which equipment measured a specific device over time for traceability and debugging.
acceptanceCriteria: Create get_equipment_connections_for_device(p_solar_cell_id text, p_pixel text DEFAULT 'No pixel') function
Function returns: equipment_id, equipment_type, equipment_metadata, connection_datetime, disconnection_datetime, notes
Function orders by connection_datetime DESC
Function filters by solar_cell_id and pixel
Test function with sample query in migration (commented example)
Migration runs successfully
userStories.notes: Created get_equipment_connections_for_device in V10. This function provides a simple interface to track hardware history for any device/pixel.

userStories.title: Add migration validation and rollback plan
userStories.description: As a database administrator, I need clear validation steps and rollback procedures in case the migration fails or needs reversal.
acceptanceCriteria: Document validation queries in migration comments for: archive table row counts, new table structures, indexes created, FK constraints active
Document rollback procedure in migration header comments
Include example data insertion for new schema in comments
Migration includes clear section headers and explanatory comments
userStories.notes: Consolidated validation queries and rollback procedures in V11 migration. All migrations (V6-V11) follow the documented standards for headers, comments, and validation.
